arxiv-2410-08825.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Vincent Jugé. We revisit weight-balanced trees, also known as trees of bounded balance. Invented by Nievergelt and Reingold in 1972, these trees are obtained by assigning a weight to each node and requesting that the weight of each node should be quite larger than the weights of its children, the precise meaning of “quite larger” depending on a real-valued parameter γ \gamma .

arxiv-2508-10109.title: A constraint on the density of Jupiter’s moon Thebe from primordial dynamics
arxiv-2508-10109.creator: Ian R. Brunton, Konstantin Batygin
arxiv-2508-10109.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ian R. Brunton, Konstantin Batygin. Of the 97 known satellites in the Jovian system, the individual masses and densities of each moon have only been determined for six of them: the four Galileans, Amalthea, and Himalia. In this letter, we derive a prediction for the mean density (and mass) of Thebe, Jupiter’s sixth largest regular moon, obtaining a lower limit of ρ T ≳ 1.0 \rho_{\text{T}}\gtrsim 1.0 g/cm 3 ( m T ≳ 5 × 10 20 m_{\text{T}}\gtrsim 5\times 10^{20} g).

arxiv-2510-22103.description: Abstract The classical Erdős–Ko–Rado (EKR) theorem characterizes the maximum size of intersecting families of r r -element subsets of an n n -element set. We study EKR-type questions for independent r r -sets in pendant graph constructions, obtained by attaching to each base vertex a clique of prescribed size. Our contributions are threefold.

pmc-11479221.title: Evaluation of the Flexural Behavior of One-Way Slabs by the Amount of Carbon Grid Manufactured by Adhesive Bonding
pmc-11479221.creator: Kyung-Min Kim, Sung-Woo Park, Bhum-Keun Song, Seon-Hee Yoon
pmc-11479221.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Fiber-reinforced polymers (FRPs), which are resistant to corrosion, are used as reinforcement material for concrete. However, the flexural behavior of concrete members reinforced with FRPs can vary depending on the properties of FRPs. In this study, the flexural behavior of one-way concrete slab specimens reinforced with a new grid-type carbon-fiber-reinforced polymer (CFRP) (carbon grid) manufactured by bonding pultruded CFRP strands to an adhesive was investigated.

pmc-13129579.creator: Hiroaki Katsuyama, Takuro Ito, Kyousuke Ezura, Emdadul Haque, Atsushi Hoshino, Eiji Nitasaka, Michiyuki Ono, Shusei Sato, Sachiko Isobe, Hiroyuki Fukuoka, Nobuyoshi Watanabe, Tsutomu Kuboyama
pmc-13129579.description: Japanese morning glory (Ipomoea nil), a short day plant, has been used for studying flowering times. pmc-13683408.title: Cathepsin G and neutrophil elastase control Leishmania infantum parasitism through TLRs-dependent induction of IFN-α and TNF-α
pmc-13683408.creator: Amy Goundry, Aislan C Vivarini, Nathalia S Rodrigues, Ulisses G Lopes, Jeremy C Mottram, Ana Paula C A Lima
pmc-13683408.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Leishmania infantum and Leishmania donovani are protozoan parasites that cause visceral leishmaniasis, a potentially fatal disease targeting the liver, spleen and bone marrow. To survive, these parasites manipulate host macrophage microbicidal responses and metabolic pathways. Here, we demonstrate that the host serine proteases neutrophil elastase (NE) and cathepsin G (CG), acting in concert with Toll-like receptors TLR2, TLR3, and TLR4, induce the inflammatory cytokines IFN-α and TNF-α to control L. infantum infection in macrophages.
